verdict.rationale: The trade mark guidance page links to "View a timeline of the process", so the service publishes some indication of how long the trade mark process takes. Nothing in the pack shows current or regularly updated processing times, or figures broken down by transaction type. The patent pages only describe ways to get faster processing (green channel, business reasons), not actual durations. Missing for 10: explicitly published current processing-time figures, per-transaction-type breakdown (patents, renewals, transfers), evidence of how often times are updated, and independent corroboration.
